sources_considered.why: Original probability-based survey with direct year-over-year comparisons and published methods.
Original survey compares regulation and transparency attitudes with April 2025.
Search identified a relevant 2026 snapshot, but it did not supply the needed same-question annual comparison.
Search identified support for safeguards, which alone does not establish increased opposition to deregulation.
Search identified an industry-sponsored issue-priority survey; issue ranking is not a comparable measure of year-over-year backlash.

evidence_items.locator: Bottom Line, first sentence; Survey Methods for field dates
evidence_items.explanation: The May survey reports increased negative views of AI compared with 2025. It measures AI generally, not generative AI or opposition to a specific deregulation policy, so it is directional context.

Dissatisfaction with business transparency was largely unchanged, while the adjacent regulation comparison reports increased dissatisfaction with government oversight. The findings therefore do not show uniform escalation across all attitudes, and they do not isolate opposition to deregulation.

unresolved_gaps: The inspected repeated surveys concern AI generally rather than generative AI specifically.
No comparable full-year measure of opposition to specific deregulation policies was established.
The sources do not meet the early-resolution rule.
